presets.name: Gentle warmth
presets.description: A little even-harmonic warmth, hardly louder.

presets.name: Asymmetric tube
presets.description: An uneven curve, like an overdriven valve: rich even harmonics.

presets.name: Tape glue
presets.description: Rounds the peaks of a group like tape does.

presets.name: Warm bus
presets.description: A touch of drive and asymmetry for a group or the mix.

presets.name: Keys warmth
presets.description: Tape-style drive, a little more in the low mids.

presets.name: Mid push (Color)
presets.description: Saturates the mids around 1.5 kHz more than the rest, so the part comes forward.

presets.name: Vocal edge
presets.description: Edge in the upper mids, blended under the clean voice.

presets.name: Bass grit
presets.description: Grit in the mids while the low end stays round.

presets.name: Sub harmonics
presets.description: Adds harmonics to the lows, so the bass reads on small speakers.

presets.name: Hard clip
presets.description: Shaves the peaks off for loudness; push Drive for more.

presets.name: Parallel grit
presets.description: Hard clipping blended low under the dry sound.

presets.name: Lo-fi fuzz
presets.description: Fuzz with a honky mid push.

presets.name: Fold FX
presets.description: Wavefolding: the louder it plays, the more the tone shifts.

presets.name: Octave rectify
presets.description: Rectification adds an octave up: for leads, guitars and synths.
